buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider

2. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses TERMS AND CONDITIONS – FOR HIRING SERVICE PROVIDER FOR STAFF IN DRI, COIMBATORE ZONAL UNIT The requirement is for providing Staff for the Directorate of Revenue Intelligence, Coi mbatore Regional Unit, 1103, Trichy Road, Coimbatore - 641018. 1. The Service Provider shall be based in Coimbatore having a minimum turnover of Rs.20,00,000/- (Rupees Twenty lakh only) per annum and above in each of th e earlier three financial years (2025-26, 2024-25 & 2023-24). Copies of the audi ted Balance Sheet and Profit & Loss Account duly Certified by a Chartered Acco untant for the years mentioned above should be uploaded as proof in this regar d. (Documents like self-certification of turnover, certified income statement pre pared for IT, etc. will not be considered). 2. The Service Provider shall submit an amount equal to one month’s payment as Performance Guarantee Deposit in the form of Bank guarantee from a Nationali zed Bank/ Demand Draft/ Banker’s Cheque of a Schedule Bank drawn in favour of “Senior Intelligence Officer, DRI” within 10 days of awarding and accepting th e Contract. The Performance Guarantee shall be refunded to the Service Provid er without any interest within three months from completion of the Contract Per iod, and in case of any default in payment, the same may be subjected to forfeit ure. 3. The Service provider shall have a minimum experience of three years in provid ing services in other Government departments. The Service provider shall have a registered / branch office / running fixed establishment in Coimbatore. 4. The Service provider should submit proof of the following: a) PAN CARD b) Income tax returns for past 3 years

c) GST registration d) GST returns for past 3 years e) Providing housekeeping service in Government departments for past 3 yea rs f) Registration Certificate of the company g) License from statutory authorities 5. The persons to be deployed should have knowledge of Tamil and should not be changed by the service provider without prior intimation to the designated offic er of this office. 6. The service provider should not have been blacklisted by any Government / Se mi-Government or any other organization. Bidders whose contracts have been t erminated / foreclosed by any employer during the last 3 years due to non-fulfill ment of contractual obligation / non-compliance of statutory obligations are not eligible to bid. The bidder should clearly specify and submit letters in writing se parately stating that they do not fall under this category. 7. In case of any default by the service provider in any of the terms & conditions ( whether General or Special), DRI may without prejudice to any other right/reme dy which shall have accrued or shall accrue thereafter, terminates the contract, in whole or part, by giving 30 days’ notice in writing to the service provider. Ser vice provider shall in no case lease/transfer/sublet/appoint care taker for the se rvices contracted. 8. The period of contract would be for two years. Service charges fixed by GeM w ould be applicable. 9. No other persons except service providers’ authorized representative shall be allowed to enter the DRI office. Within the premises of DRI, the service provider’ s personnel shall not do any private work other than their normal duties. 10. Service provider shall be directly responsible for any/all disputes arising betwe en him and his personnel and keep the DRI indemnified against all action,

losses, damages, expenses and claims whatsoever arising thereof. 11. Service provider shall be solely responsible for payment of wages/salaries, othe r benefits and allowances (including any overtime charges, etc.) to his personne l that might become applicable under any Act or Order of the Govt. DRI shall ha ve no liability whatsoever in this regard and the service provider shall indemnify DRI against any/all claims which may arise under the provisions of various Act, Govt.’s orders etc. 12. Contractor shall be fully responsible for theft, burglary, fire or any mischievous deeds by his staff. Contractor shall ensure that the persons sent to DRI are neat and in clean while on duty and free from any communicable diseases. He shall t rain them for office appropriate behavior / manners and maintain personal hygi ene. 13. It will be obligatory on the part of the service provider for the safe upkeep and proper handling of the office equipment to be used by the staff. If any damage i s caused to the office equipment on account of negligence of the person deploy ed, the service provider will be liable for action under law and the loss / damage s so caused will be paid, by/recovered from the service provider. 14. The service provider will submit the monthly bills for claiming charges for having provided services in duplicate enclosing therein certificate, which shall b e duly certified by the officer-in-charge and the same shall be paid thereof after making recovery, if any. Payment of monthly bill towards deploying personnel i n this office will be after deducting statutory deductions viz. TDS of 2% on contr act services under Income Tax Act, 1961 and TDS on GST @ 2%. 15. The Service Provider shall submit the monthly bills and the salary be credited t o the employees within the 3rd of each month without undue delay as per instru ctions issued vide Department of Expenditure OM dated 08.05.2026. The Servic e Provider shall also furnish a detailed Salary Slip for each individual every mon

th. Any delay in payment of wages by over a month will be subject to t ermination of contract and blacklisting. 16. Proof of having made the mandatory payments in respect of ESI/ EPF must be s ubmitted along with the subsequent month bill. Further, it may be ensured that the personnel deployed in this office are paid with minimum wages as per the o rders issued by the Chief Labour Commissioner, New Delhi in force from time to time. No commission/ deduction other than ESI/EPF/ Bonus shall be mad e from the salary of the individuals. If any unnecessary deduction is m ade, the contract is liable to be cancelled and the contractor shall be b lacklisted. 17. All the existing statutory regulations of both State & Central Governments shall be adhered to & complied with and all records maintained thereof should be av ailable for scrutiny by this office. 18. The Service provider shall strictly comply with the terms and conditions of the agreement which will be executed with the successful bidder. Failure by the ser vice provider to comply with such statutory requirements and / or the terms of t he agreement during the period of contract or deficiency in services shall result in termination of the contract. DRI is entitled to withhold payments due to the s ervice provider in case of any dispute, till it is resolved. 19. In case of any dispute of any kind and in any respect whatsoever, the decision of the DRI shall be final and binding. 20. The service provider shall ensure that the persons deployed in this office have executed non-disclosure agreement whereby they shall not disclose anything p ertaining to this office at all costs. 21. The service provider shall have a working capital to meet at least three month s gross wages / salaries of the personnel deployed in this office and there shall not be any outstanding dues to the personnel provided to this office.

22. A Pre-Bid meeting will be conducted on the specified date, time and place as m entioned in the bid document. The technical bids of service providers who subm it their bids without attending the pre-bid meeting shall not be considered and s hall be rejected. 23. For any clarification in the matter prior appointment may be taken from: a) Sh. Arun Rajeeth R, Tax Assistant Contact No. 89404 67544 b) Sh. Aaditya, Tax Assistant Contact No. 99588 50179 . 4.
